# .github/commands

Gemini CLI command definitions consumed by GitHub Actions.

## Files
- `gemini-invoke.toml` — General autonomous software engineering agent prompt.
- `gemini-plan-execute.toml` — Plan-verification-first execution prompt.
- `gemini-review.toml` — Pull request review prompt with diff-scoped commenting rules.
- `gemini-triage.toml` — Single-issue label classification prompt.
- `gemini-scheduled-triage.toml` — Batch issue triage prompt with strict JSON output.
